title: QIDI's CPU tuning script runs about every 1.5 min instead of every ~35 s
note: qidi-tuning.service runs QIDI's tuning.sh (Type=simple, Restart=always, RestartSec=3). The script sets CPU affinity and priorities for Klipper, Moonraker, nginx, the camera and the screen program, pins the MCU serial and USB interrupts, and exits after its 30 s start-up wait - so systemd started it again about every 35 s, forever, each run walking the process list (seen on the Q2: 22 restarts in the first 13 minutes). A drop-in sets RestartSec=60: the same settings, re-applied about every 1.5 min (e.g. after Klipper restarts). QIDI's files are not changed. Uninstall removes the drop-in.
